Nullam scelerisque, arcu ac auctor tristique, magna risus tincidunt augue, eu consectetur urna mauris in lectus. </p></div></div><div class="element" data-id="pbl8jv" data-type="button"><div class="element-wrap"><div class="pagex-button-wrapper"><a class="pagex-button-link pagex-static-link" href="#"><div class="pagex-button justify-content-end"><div class="pagex-button-content pagex-lang-str">More About Us</div></div></a></div></div></div></div></div></div></div><div class="section" data-id="pp0glw" data-type="section"><div class="container" data-id="pwkciv" data-type="container"><div class="row" data-id="p0ahsl" data-type="row"><div class="col" data-id="p7td78" data-type="column"><div class="element" data-id="p0pfgt" data-type="separator"><div class="element-wrap"><div class="pagex-separator-wrapper"><div class="pagex-separator"><div class="pagex-separator-line pagex-separator-left-line"></div></div></div></div></div></div></div></div></div><div class="section" data-id="po3mw4" data-type="section"><div class="container" data-id="p98w88" data-type="container"><div class="row" data-id="psw7bq" data-type="row"><div class="col-8" data-id="pgj6ns" data-type="column"><div class="element" data-id="psz9gn" data-type="post_data"><div class="element-wrap"><div class="pagex-post-data"><div class="pagex-post-data-item pagex-post-data-custom-type"><div class="pagex-post-data-value"><h3 class="pagex-post-data-wrapper-tag">Kite Vacations</h3></div></div><div class="pagex-post-data-divider"></div></div></div></div><div class="element" data-id="pzzkb5" data-type="heading"><div class="element-wrap"><p class="pagex-heading pagex-content-editable pagex-lang-str"><b>Already a kiter and looking for a wind-powered vacation<br>with maximum support and water time?</b></p></div></div><div class="element" data-id="pe71lv" data-type="heading"><div class="element-wrap"><p class="pagex-heading pagex-content-editable pagex-lang-str">Palapas Ventana is your spot!!! With steady side on winds from Nov - April, a private launch, uncrowded riding, a wave out in front during the El Norte days, our launch and land assistant on the beach helping you, on the water gear storage, an on-site kite school and gear shop, daily downwinder service and compressed air fills, Palapas Ventana will spoil you and your crew. With 2 meals a day included and our restaurant open nightly for dinners, you will get more kiting time every day while we handle the details!!! We run kite trips to Cerralvo Island for the iconic Crossing of the La Ventana Classic, and also kitesurf trips to the Pacific side to get your wave fix. Your stay comes complete with wifi, pool, Jacuzzi, bar, bikes and custom service. Plus we have a full array of low wind activities for the mornings.</p></div></div></div></div></div></div> </div>
